about_the_game:
The digital artbook for Marisa of Liartop Mountain

Contains 5 pdf files, for: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.

To access the artbook

1. In your Steam library, right click『Marisa of Liartop Mountain』, and select "Property"

2. Ensure the artbook is installed from the property window of "DLC"

3. In your Steam library, right click『Marisa of Liartop Mountain』click on "Manage" > "Browse local files"

4. File Explorer will open

5. The artbook will be located inside the「Digital Artwork」folder

*The contents of this digital artbook are the same as that of the "Digital Artwork" in "Marisa of Liartop Mountain: Digital Artwork & Sound Player" contained in the Nintendo Switch Version "Marisa of Liartop Mountain Digital Deluxe Edition"

For those who own the above products, please be wary of duplicate purchases
